lines: The MERIDIAN-7 Hub. It's conspicuously cleaner than anything else in the city — polished surfaces, soft ambient lighting, climate-controlled air.
A large holographic display cycles through advertisements: energy solutions, trade opportunities, 'partnership programs.' The Array's aesthetic is unmistakable.

options.label: Sol Shield Emitter
options.description: Defensive ability component. Creates energy barrier. Costs significant resources.

options.label: Charge Sol Unit
options.description: Fully recharge your Sol Unit's energy.

lines: The terminal hums. A compartment slides open revealing the Sol Shield Emitter.
MERIDIAN-7 speaks: 'Sol Shield Emitter — defensive capability. Place in your Sol Grid. Activation creates a brief energy barrier that absorbs incoming damage.'
'We recommend placing it adjacent to a Power Tap for optimal performance. Enjoy your purchase.'

actions.text: The terminal emits a warm pulse. Your Sol Unit's energy cells fill to capacity. 'Charging complete. The Array powers progress.'
A soft chime. 'Premium access detected. Enhanced services available. Welcome back.'

lines: MERIDIAN-7: 'As a premium partner, please accept this complimentary supply package.'
'Your exploration data has been most valuable. I look forward to learning more about your... experiences in the field.'

actions.prompt: MERIDIAN-7 has a special request. It needs refined umbrasite from the deep Nightside.

options.label: Accept
options.description: Venture into the Nightside Depths and retrieve refined umbrasite for the Array.

lines: MERIDIAN-7: 'Excellent. I have marked the general direction on your HUD. The deep Nightside caverns lie beyond the expanded dark — south from the deep perimeter.'
'The refined specimens are found in the deepest formations. You will know them when you see them.'
'Return with the crystal and the Umbral Amplifier is yours. The Array keeps its commitments.'

actions.text: MERIDIAN-7: 'Understood. The offer remains open. Return when you are prepared.'

lines: The terminal hums with a new intensity. A compartment slides open, revealing the Umbral Amplifier — dark circuitry that shimmers with captured Nightside energy.
MERIDIAN-7: 'The crystal has been integrated. Processing efficiency is already improving. You have the Array's gratitude — and its attention.'
'The Umbral Amplifier will serve you well. Place it in your Sol Grid adjacent to an ability emitter for maximum effect.'
'And Lightkeeper — if you find more refined specimens in your travels, the Array's appetite is... considerable.'
